inputs.coverage: This is the published 2006 combined radar and lightcurve model. The north polar region is poorly constrained and some structure there may be a fitting artifact. Its diameter uncertainty is about 20%. Later lightcurves favor a different pole and measured rotational acceleration; this historical model retains its original pole and period with arbitrary display phase, not a current attitude. No resolved optical surface map is supplied.
